answers.question: After the determinism fix, which encrypted rows actually pass?
answers.answer: 15 pass and 1 fails. The failing row (C56 SING N=1024 publicMS B=1 k=7, rc=133) is printed in the ledger rather than omitted.

timingContext.interpretation: The capture replays preserved text at normal speed. Any elapsed-time figures visible on screen are historical observations from the original run on one Apple-silicon host, not fresh measurements and not portable performance contracts.

claimBoundaries: This is playback of a preserved ledger. No encrypted run was performed for the capture.
The per-row wall-clock seconds are local Apple-silicon observations, not portable timings.
Noise-measurement rows are completeness evidence and are not the functional gate.
The k=7 failure is a real open row and is shown as FAIL.
Native-dimension noisy PicoRV32 SING remains failed/open and is not recovered by these rows.
A passing SING row at a given N does not mean the separate 2^-64 noise bar clears at that N.
